The table lists every atom of one conventional cubic cell of Al5 Y3 O12 (Al5 O12 Y3, COD 1529037) as fractional coordinates. Use the kinematic structure factor F(hkl) = Σ_j Z_j exp[2πi(h x_j + k y_j + l z_j)] with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights (Al = 13, O = 8, Y = 39). Exactly one of the four reflections below has |F| = 0. Which one?

选项：
A. (4 0 0)
B. (2 2 2)
C. (2 1 1)
D. (2 2 0)

附件：EN-COD1529037-EXT-cell.txt（均为本题完整输入）。范围：常规晶胞按 CIF 全部对称操作展开（task_families/cell.py）；周期晶体；衍射题为运动学模型与原子序数权重。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
